purpose: E163 showed that E65 correlation-logSPD fused with the E162 raw-EEG embedding only reached diagnostic AUC 0.7609 (W 0.7164), i.e. the E162 stream adds little separability. E148 showed log band power alone has diagnostic AUC 0.7772 (above E65 0.7578) and E65+logbp feature concat reaches 0.7894, but it was never tried as a score-level fusion. E165 proved E65 is invariant to channel/band gain and circular shift, so logbp carries exactly the amplitude information E65 destroys. This run repeats the verbatim E163 fusion protocol on the E65 x logbp pair.

E65_logspd.note: 855-d correlation log-SPD vector, the E143 representation

logbp.note: 90-d log band power (5 bands x 18 channels), amplitude information that E65 standardises away

hjorth.note: 36-d Hjorth mobility/complexity, only used for the optional three-way score fusion

standardisation.rule: per stream, task-wise z-score with Train-session1 statistics only (all Train rows of that task), identical to E143/E163 so the E65 control reproduces 0.7578 / 0.6958 exactly

variants.raw: concat(E65 PCA, logbp PCA) then joint PCA
variants.block_norm: each PCA block divided by its fit-row RMS so both contribute equal total variance, then joint PCA

score_fusion.selection_metric: Train LOSO AUC of the fused z-score; Test is never consulted
score_fusion.z_normalisation: each stream score z-scored with its own 5-block Train OOF mean/std before weighting

protocol.prototypes: k-means (E143 seeding, 20 iters) per (task, identity) on fit_rows only
protocol.train_oof: 5 contiguous frac blocks, prototypes rebuilt without the held block
protocol.threshold: quantile of the 5-block Train OOF score at each acceptance rate; LOSO uses the per-fold known-block quantile
protocol.test: scored only; session used only for the post-hoc diagnostic AUC

reporting.test_official: N/A: the Test split has no public labels; session labels are used only for the diagnostic AUC after scoring
